name: 53546 · Janesville, WI
findings: ZIP 53546 (Janesville) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53546 (Janesville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
